subject.title: feat(context): add local context-usage breakdown for session rows

question: Should this PR be allowed to introduce `js-tiktoken` into the root runtime dependency graph for session diagnostics, or should the feature be redesigned without that dependency?
rationale: Repository automation explicitly blocks external dependency-graph changes unless a repository admin or the named security group authorizes the current head; that authorization cannot be inferred from unit tests or the PR description.

options.title: Redesign without a new root dependency
options.body: Use an already-approved internal capability or a bounded approximation path, then retain explicit approximate labeling and add runtime proof.

options.title: Authorize the dependency intentionally
options.body: A repository admin or `@openclaw/openclaw-secops` can authorize this exact head after independently reviewing the package and its runtime footprint.

recommendation.title: Redesign without a new root dependency
recommendation.body: Use an already-approved internal capability or a bounded approximation path, then retain explicit approximate labeling and add runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The posted dependency guard explicitly assigns authorization of this exact class of change to this security route.
